text: dsh-mcptoon 是一个面向 DSH 的 MCP 工具接入 bundle，通过 profile patch 注册官方 MCP client，以 stdio 方式启动 mcptoon serve，让已配置的上游 MCP 工具经压缩后的定义呈现给 agent。它还会在激活时检查 mcptoon 命令是否可用，并在失败时给出路径覆盖提示；附带 doctor 命令可打印配置建议。适合希望减少大量 MCP 工具发现描述开销的 DSH 用户。使用前需在本机安装 mcptoon CLI 并确保可执行文件可解析。

dsh-mcptoon is a DSH bundle that adds an MCP client to a profile and starts mcptoon serve over stdio. It exposes configured upstream tools through compressed definitions, checks the command on activation, and includes a doctor CLI with path guidance. Install the mcptoon CLI locally before use.
想把多个已配置的 MCP 服务通过一个 stdio 连接提供给 DSH。
DSH 能不能用压缩后的 MCP 工具描述来减少发现开销？
让 DSH profile 自动挂载本机的 mcptoon MCP server。
mcptoon 命令找不到时，怎样知道该在配置里填哪个路径？
我想检查 MCP 桥接程序是否能在 DSH 启动环境中运行。
How can I expose my configured MCP tools through one stdio server in DSH?
I want to reduce the token overhead of discovering many MCP tool schemas in my DSH profile.
How do I find the executable path when my local MCP bridge command is missing?
dsh-mcptoon 的功能「挂载 MCP 服务」：patch 注册 MCP client，并通过 stdio 启动 mcptoon serve，使 DSH agent 可访问已配置的上游 MCP 工具。
dsh-mcptoon 的功能「激活自检」：插件激活时异步探测配置的 mcptoon 命令并记录检查结果；命令不可用时向日志输出修复提示，不让诊断异常中断宿主启动。
dsh-mcptoon 的功能「doctor 路径诊断」：运行 doctor CLI 后会检查 mcptoon 可执行文件；检查失败时打印 profile patch 的路径覆盖示例，成功时报告无需覆盖。
dsh-mcptoon 的功能「命令可达性探测」：自检以 mcptoon --version 探测安装情况，执行带超时限制并禁用 shell；用户可在插件配置中覆盖可执行文件路径。
dsh-mcptoon 使用前须知：需安装 mcptoon CLI；默认从 PATH 调用，也可为 command 指定绝对路径。（见 cordis.patch.yml:20-25）

dsh-mcptoon README · dsh-mcptoon：> English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) plugin bundle that mounts
[mcptoon](https://pypi.org/project/mcptoon/) as an MCP server in one command, so
the host agent discovers its MCP tools through mcptoon's compressed view instead
of paying full JSON schemas on every turn.

dsh-mcptoon README · dsh-mcptoon：**Measured on a 255-tool workspace: tool discovery drops 71,929 -> 581 tokens across 255 tools (-99.2%, measured).** The encoding is lossless — `mcptoon` only
changes how tool definitions travel, never what they say.

dsh-mcptoon README · What you get：After installing, the model sees `mcp__mcptoon__<tool>` — the same
server-qualified naming other MCP hosts use — and every upstream MCP server you
have already configured is proxied behind that single stdio connection.

dsh-mcptoon README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:activeing123/dsh-mcptoon
```

Or, once the package is on npm:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mcptoon
```

Then restart the profile (or rely on HMR: editing the entry reconnects the bridge
without a process restart).

dsh-mcptoon README · Requirements：- Python 3.9+ with the mcptoon CLI on `PATH`: `pip install mcptoon` (zero
  dependencies, installs in seconds).
- Review the version before you upgrade: `pip install "mcptoon==<reviewed>"` is
  the safer default than an unconditional `--upgrade`.

dsh-mcptoon README · If the bridge does not come up：The bundle prints a self-check line at activation. When it says `not ready`, the
CLI is not where `command` points — common on Windows, where `pip` installs
`mcptoon.exe` next to an interpreter that is not on `PATH`, often under a path
containing a space (`C:\Program Files\...`).

Get the absolute path — the bundled doctor prints the exact override block:

dsh-mcptoon README · If the bridge does not come up：```sh
npx dsh-mcptoon-doctor          # or: node bin/doctor.mjs inside a checkout
python -c "import shutil;print(shutil.which('mcptoon'))"
```

Then override in your profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` — **one executable in
`command`, arguments in the `args` array, never a spaced shell string**:

```yaml
- id: mcp-mcptoon
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
  config:
    serverName: mcptoon

Sanity-check the composed profile without booting the app:

dsh-mcptoon README · How it works：This package is a *bundle*: its `package.json` declares
`dsh.bundle.patch`, and the patch file it points at inserts one entry into the
profile's plugin list — an instance of the official
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` bridge configured for `mcptoon serve`. The bundle
only ever `insert`s; it never rewrites entries it does not own.

dsh-mcptoon README · Relationship to the Claude Code plugin：mcptoon also ships a Claude Code plugin (`plugin.json` + `SKILL.md` +
`.mcp.json`) in the upstream repository. That packaging was the first to bundle
MCP management and compression as an installable plugin. **This DSH bundle is a
second host wrapper, not an endorsement or official support statement from
either project.**
